name: Goa
full_description: Goa is India's pocket-sized paradise, known for its endless beaches, stellar nightlife, and Portuguese-influenced architecture.

name: Munnar
full_description: Munnar is a town and hill station located in the Idukki district of Kerala, famous for its lush tea estates and misty mountains.

name: Varanasi
full_description: Varanasi, the spiritual capital of India, is one of the world's oldest continually inhabited cities, sacred to Hindus and Buddhists.

name: Hanle
full_description: Hanle is a remote village in Ladakh, home to the Indian Astronomical Observatory and offering the clearest night skies in India.

name: Rishikesh
full_description: Rishikesh is where spiritual seekers come for yoga and adrenaline junkies come for white-water rafting on the holy Ganges.
best_time_to_visit: March to May, Sept to Nov

name: Udaipur
full_description: Udaipur, formerly the capital of the Mewar Kingdom, is a city in Rajasthan known for its lavish royal residences and artificial lake system.

name: Hampi
full_description: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage site dotted with ruins of temples, monolithic sculptures, and forts from the 14th-century empire.

name: Alleppey
full_description: Alleppey is famous for its backwater houseboats, lagoons, and palm-fringed canals where life moves at a serene pace.

name: Leh
full_description: Leh is a high-altitude desert city in Ladakh, offering dramatic landscapes, Buddhist monasteries, and world-class trekking.
